title: Behavioral and Psychological Treatments for Chronic Insomnia Disorder in Adults
doc_summary:
Here are 7 concise bullet points summarizing the recommendations for behavioral and psychological treatments for chronic insomnia disorder in adults:
* Use multicomponent cognitive-behavioral therapy for insomnia as the primary treatment
* Consider using multicomponent brief behavioral therapies as an alternative
* Stimulus control can be used as a single-component therapy
* Sleep restriction therapy can be used as a single-component therapy
* Relaxation therapy can be used as a single-component therapy
* Do not use sleep hygiene as a single-component therapy
* Provide general sleep education, including information about sleep hygiene practices, as part of standard care
